changelog: FIX (CRITICAL — Fire Stick stalls): Tightened the player's HTTPS timeouts (was 15 s connect / 20 s read, now 4 s / 8 s). Crash reports showed the 'black screen for 10–20 seconds, then app feels frozen' symptom was actually a single hung manifest fetch riding the old 30+ s budget. Recovery now kicks in inside the 'Reconnecting…' overlay window so it looks like a brief buffer, not a crash.
FIX: Resolved Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning during install.
FIX: Player on-screen options menu — D-pad now actually selects options.
FIX: Settings shows $50 CAD / year correctly.
FIX: Discovery hero TMDB backdrop fallback.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
